gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-gidole: Gidole draws its strokes like neon tubing, with terminals held apart and a high midline. Stentiga is the one for spread-out, luxurious display lettering, while Gidole does its best work as a plain sans for steady text.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Stentiga traces its letters in a constant-width outline you could follow with a finger, spaced out and refined. Hedvig Letters Sans keeps a longer read friendly, its small letters nearly capital height and each c left with a wide gap.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-heebo: Spread out and richly stately, Stentiga lets its wide-open letters take their time with no thick-thin swing. Heebo, a tall-banded sans-serif, handles the text below; try it at a modest size.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hind-madurai: Stentiga's crossbars are as thick as its stems, and its tracking is opened right up for a luxurious stretch. Hind Madurai keeps its s curves wide at both ends, so the big, short lines belong to Stentiga alone.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hind-mysuru: Refined and luxurious, Stentiga spreads its letters wide, each opening left like a door just ajar. Hind Mysuru takes the text, with tall lowercase and no calligraphic thinning.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hind-siliguri: Spacious and polished, Stentiga stretches its tracking and gives every crossbar the heft of a stem. Hind Siliguri hums along beneath it; a slightly generous size lets its cracked-bangle rounds breathe.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hind-vadodara: Luxurious, spread-out Stentiga leads with refined confidence. Hind Vadodara follows with a clean, uniform line and spacious gaps in its rounds, so one feels like a showpiece and the other like quiet, tidy support.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and tidy, its lowercase rising close to cap height with s terminals kept clear of the body. Stentiga is best when large and spaced out, and Huninn does its finest work on the lines that follow.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-inter-tight: Stentiga spreads its refined, luxurious letters wide, crossbars as thick as stems and each opening left ajar. Inter Tight follows with short ascenders and held-back curve tails, so reading stays smooth.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-karla: Wide, refined and a bit grand, Stentiga holds one plain stripe of ink from start to finish. Karla brings a gaping c and a stocky tall middle band, so a modest size should keep it comfortable.
